limitForwardAcceleration(Translation2d, Translation2d, double, double) - Static method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveUtils
Steps currentVelocity one 20ms cycle towards desiredVelocity, capping acceleration in the current direction of travel only (a speed-dependent cap: it tapers to 0 as currentVelocity approaches maxVelocity).
limitForwardAndSkidAcceleration(Translation2d, Translation2d, double, double, double) - Static method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveUtils
Combines SwerveUtils.limitForwardAcceleration(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d, double, double) and SwerveUtils.limitSkidAcceleration(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d, double) in one step: caps forward acceleration with a speed-dependent taper, then additionally caps the resulting acceleration magnitude for skid protection.
limits - Variable in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.constants.RealControllerConstants.HardLimits
The configured limit switches; indices here match the index argument of Controller.getLimit(int).
limitSkidAcceleration(Translation2d, Translation2d, double) - Static method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveUtils
Steps currentVelocity one 20ms cycle towards desiredVelocity, capping the magnitude of the acceleration vector uniformly in every direction (unlike SwerveUtils.limitForwardAcceleration(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d, double, double), which only limits acceleration along the current heading).
